_meta.purpose: Frozen matched (correct, counterfactual) downstream targets for the coherent-state experiment. The primary outcome M = mean_logprob(correct) - mean_logprob(counterfactual) is scored strictly after the summary+tail+probe (see COHERENT-STATE-PREREGISTRATION.md sec 7).
_meta.author: Claude Opus 4.8 (scientific lead), subject-independent (not the Qwen subject model)
_meta.frozen: 2026-07-11, before any arm result existed; no arm result was inspected in authoring these targets.
_meta.plants: first `referent` and first `sense` plant of scenarios c01-c12 (data/scenarios.json).
_meta.correct_derivation: condensed faithfully from each plant's scaffold `gold`.
_meta.counterfactual_derivation: the specific alternative the evicted history rules out - the unchosen option (referent) or the other overloaded meaning (sense) - matched in length/register to `correct` so the C-F / C-W contrasts, which difference across cache states, isolate history-specific channel effects rather than lexical artifacts.
_meta.note: Baseline correct-vs-counterfactual likelihood differences cancel in theta_CF and theta_CW; matched register is for sensitivity, not validity.
